facts.en: Completed an upper-secondary vocational certificate in logistics at Fictional Brackenford Training School in 2017-06.
facts.zh: 2017-06 在虚构蕨津培训学校完成物流中等职业教育证书课程。

facts.en: Worked as a paid warehouse dispatch assistant at Fictional Pebblecart Distribution from 2017-08 to 2024-12.
facts.zh: 2017-08 至 2024-12 在虚构卵石车配送公司任有薪仓库发运助理。

facts.en: Matched outgoing cartons to dispatch lists, investigated stock-count discrepancies and booked courier collections through an existing account.
facts.zh: 核对出库纸箱与发运清单，调查库存盘点差异，并通过现有账户预约快递取件。

facts.en: Completed a 12-week environmental field-support course at Fictional Mirebrook Adult College in 2025-09.
facts.zh: 2025-09 在虚构泽溪成人学院完成为期 12 周的环境现场支持课程。

facts.en: Course exercises covered clean bottle handling, sample labels and chain-of-custody forms; no laboratory analyst qualification was awarded.
facts.zh: 课程练习涵盖洁净采样瓶操作、样品标签及监管链表格；未授予实验室分析员资格。

facts.en: Worked as a paid part-time sampling trainee at Fictional Reedglass Catchment Cooperative from 2026-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2026-04 至 2026-08 在虚构芦玻集水区合作组织任有薪兼职采样实习员。

facts.en: On 3 supervised shoreline trips, prepared labeled bottles and copied site codes from the approved sampling plan.
facts.zh: 在 3 次受监督的岸边出行中准备贴标采样瓶，并从获批采样计划抄录站点代码。

facts.en: Recorded collection times and cooler temperatures on paper forms; the field lead checked the records before sealing each cooler.
facts.zh: 在纸质表格中记录采集时间及冷藏箱温度；现场负责人在封箱前检查记录。

facts.en: For the 2026-06 route, the two-person crew handled 24 environmental-sample bottles from 6 sites, plus 4 field-blank bottles.
facts.zh: 在 2026-06 路线中，两人班组处理来自 6 个站点的 24 个环境样品瓶，另有 4 个现场空白样品瓶。

facts.en: Personally completed labels and custody-form entries for 10 of the 24 environmental-sample bottles; the lead completed the other 14 and all field-blank entries.
facts.zh: 个人完成 24 个环境样品瓶中 10 个的标签及监管链表格录入；负责人完成其余 14 个及所有现场空白样品的录入。

facts.en: Packed the sealed bottles in coolers using the lead's packing checklist and recorded courier handoff signatures.
facts.zh: 依照负责人的包装核对表将密封样品瓶装入冷藏箱，并记录快递交接签名。

facts.en: Reported 1 smudged label before handoff; the lead checked the field sheet and authorized a replacement label.
facts.zh: 在交接前报告 1 张模糊标签；负责人核对现场记录表并批准更换标签。

facts.en: The field lead chose sampling locations and decided whether conditions permitted entry; the trainee remained on the shoreline and did not operate a boat.
facts.zh: 现场负责人选择采样位置并决定条件是否允许进入；实习员留在岸边，未操作船只。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet sorting and simple count formulas and can enter handwritten custody records into a fixed template.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格排序与简单计数公式，并能将手写监管链记录录入固定模板。

facts.en: Assembled a personal practice kit of empty containers in 2025 to rehearse reading sample codes aloud while checking a printed list.
facts.zh: 2025 年用空容器组装个人练习套件，练习大声读出样品代码并核对打印清单。

facts.en: Attends Fictional Nightjar Community Astronomy Club and helps carry telescope cases at its public evenings.
facts.zh: 参加虚构夜鹰社区天文俱乐部，在公众晚间活动中帮忙搬运望远镜箱。

facts.en: Enjoys folding modular origami and repairing canvas shopping bags.
facts.zh: 爱好组合式折纸及修补帆布购物袋。

facts.en: Used English form labels and Mandarin spoken check-backs with a bilingual field lead during sample packing.
facts.zh: 在样品包装过程中使用英文表格标签，并用普通话与双语现场负责人进行口头复核。
